items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 9 at 5:38AM AKST until November 10 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...Southern Kenai Mtns including Seward.

* WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 3 AM AKST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile
vehicles. Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will peak this afternoon and tonight
before after midnight and early Tuesday morning.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 9 at 4:44AM AKST until November 9 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A strong system is expected to move through the area Monday.
Temperatures below freezing combined with snow levels below 1,000 ft
are indicative of snowfall for upper elevations. Mid-level
southeasterly flow suggests potential for White Pass to be sheltered
from much of the precipitation, but would allow for ample moisture to
make it into the Haines Borough, falling as snow at the border along
the Haines Highway.

items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 9 at 4:44AM AKST until November 9 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A strong system is expected to move through the area Monday.
Temperatures below freezing combined with snow levels below 1,000 ft
are indicative of snowfall for upper elevations. Mid-level
southeasterly flow suggests potential for White Pass to be sheltered
from much of the precipitation, but would allow for ample moisture to
make it into the Haines Borough, falling as snow at the border along

* WHAT...Heavy snow possible. Total snow accumulations of 8 to 12
inches possible.
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. For the latest road conditions where
available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 9 at 4:41AM AKST until November 9 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds are expected to impact the
gulf coast and southern portions of the island Monday morning
through the early afternoon.
items.instruction:

weather.gov/Juneau/StormReports.
